messages:
maya: FYI bringing up cyclone-17b (int4) canary. microbatch=1 + kv-prefetch on. stress suite hits OOMs on long sessions (~30k tokens). logs attached.

drew: which quant backend? block-quant or per-layer?

maya: block-quant with hybrid fallback. defaults: max_new_tokens=1024, prefetch.window_tokens=512.

liam: fragmentation usually appears with long gen windows. can you repro with kv_prefetch=false?

maya: disabling prefetch stops the OOM at 1024 but throughput drops ~8%. max_new_tokens=256 + prefetch=true passes.

ana: saw this on certon too. reducing prefetch.window_tokens helps. try 128 and batching.window_ms=6.

maya: tested prefetch.window_tokens=128 + max_new_tokens=1024 -> stable on canary. heap spikes gone, throughput ~3% lower.

drew: also try enabling slot compaction + soft eviction for long-lived KV. config I used:
"inference": { "batching": {"window_ms":6}, "kv": {"prefetch": {"window_tokens":128}, "slot_compaction":true, "soft_evict_threshold_pct":85}, "generation": {"max_new_tokens":1024} }

maya: applied locally. canary stayed up under sustained load 30m. KV evictions show in traces but graceful.

ops-bot: canary rollout -> 3 nodes us-west-2. alerts on.

maya: proposed plan:
1) lower default max_new_tokens to 512 for cyclone-17b to reduce tail risk
2) set model profile prefetch.window_tokens=128
3) enable slot_compaction + soft_evict in canary defaults
4) add smoke/eval for 20k token generation

drew: Ill draft the PR for the model profile + smoke test in the eval harness.

liam: Ill run perf benches to quantify throughput delta and capture allocator histograms.

ana: note for release notes: mention stability trade-off (small perf hit) vs long-session OOM mitigation.

maya: thanks 44d will attach heap graphs & traces in the PR.
